channel.title: GQ US (Conde Nast) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from GQ US (Conde Nast) (gq.com)

item.title: Harrison Ford’s 34 Best Outfits of All Time
item.description: The Hollywood icon has spent six decades as a paragon of simple, handsome, American style.

item.title: Will the Next James Bond Villain Be One of These Four Actors?
item.description: No, we don't know who's playing the new James Bond—but that doesn't mean we can't speculate on whose evil plans he'll have to foil.

item.title: Alysa Liu’s Stylist Is Marty Supreme’s Oscar-Nominated Costume Designer
item.description: The Safdies’ go-to costumer, Miyako Bellizzi, is dressing her “lil town sis” in swaggy camo and Jacquemus Nikes for the gold medalist’s post-Olympics press run.

item.title: What Can a Picture of Your Poop Tell You About Your Health?
item.description: Throne, a startup based in Austin, has developed a toilet add-on that measures gut health through things like frequency, volume, and color of bowel movements.

item.title: Michelle Yeoh is Up for the Challenge
item.description: The Oscar-winning actress talks about playing five different characters in Sean Baker's new film, how Quentin Tarantino convinced her not to retire, that viral ‘Wicked Witch’ meme, and the highs and lows of her storied career. “If there's no up and down,” she says, “you've flatlined.”

item.title: How ‘ICE OUT’ Pins Became the Celebrity Accessory of the Moment
item.description: Rob Rausch, Justin Bieber, a Supreme lookbook model, and more have been spotted wearing the simple white badges protesting the Trump administration’s immigration policies. “I don’t f*** with ICE,” explains Traitors winner Rausch.

item.title: These Wallabee Lookalikes from ECCO Are So Comfortable, the Unc Accusations Don’t Bother Me
item.description: Cushy walking shoes from ECCO’s weirdest sub-label have me sliding gracefully into retirement mode.

item.title: The World Cup Is Coming to America. Here’s How to Make the Most of It
item.description: Men in Blazers founder Roger Bennett, whose book We Are the World (Cup) is out this week, answers all our burning questions about the 2026 World Cup—how to get tickets, when and where to be for the most epic off-field experiences, which teams and players to glom onto, and who’s gonna win.

item.title: 7 Best Cycling Bibs of 2026 for Riding in Style
item.description: Grab a bib and start pedaling.

item.title: 13 Best Travel Pants for Men in 2026, According to GQ
item.description: Life is too short—and lines are too long—to spend another trip wearing the sweats you woke up in.
